risk_summary: The disclosure provides meaningful quantitative liquidity and working-capital data, but relies heavily on standard forward-looking disclaimers and conditional language around COVID-19, demand, pricing, and supply-chain effects. The operating outlook is pressured by structural industry decline, competition, paper-market volatility, and pandemic uncertainty, although cash balances, credit availability, and essential operating status provide mitigating support.
